title: Report the app's errors to Sentry
prompt: src/sentry.ts initialises the Sentry SDK and exports it as `Sentry`. Report the app's unexpected errors (500 answers and failed jobs) to Sentry with Inferlo's Sentry integration, so each error in Sentry carries the route, the request id and the signed-in user's id. Do not change src/sentry.ts or the routes.
